messages:
Emma L.: quick FYI from todays periodic entitlement sweep: found 6 admin roles in project-telemetry with no owners and last used >180d. pulling list now.
Jonah P.: ouch. can you paste the role ARNs and lastActivity times?
Emma L.: paste: `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/project-telemetry-admin` lastUsed=2025-08-03, `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/telemetry-db-admin` lastUsed=2024-11-12, others similar. running `aws iam get-role --role-name ...` to confirm attached policies.
Safiya M.: thanks. timeline: we should 1) annotate these roles as "orphaned" in the entitlement tracker, 2) set read-only contact and send auto-notify to the onboarding group, 3) schedule a lock-and-flag after 7 days if no owner claimed.
infra-bot: entitlement-sweep v1.9 -- orphan_count=6 -- generated at 2026-03-20T07:12:00Z -- tickets_created=0
Jonah P.: agree. also need to ensure KMS keys used by telemetry datasets don't still trust those roles. last time a role change left a dangling key policy. can someone grep key policies for those role ARNs?
Emma L.: running `for key in $(aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' --output text); do aws kms get-key-policy --key-id $key --policy-name default | grep -E "telemetry|project-telemetry-admin" && echo $key; done` will take a minute.
Safiya M.: while that runs: decision on remediation flow? I'd prefer temp restrict (remove kms:Decrypt, add Condition StringEquals aws:PrincipalArn startsWith our acct), then owner-verification, then either full removal or documented handoff. keep changes to canary region first.
Emma L.: agree. planning to apply canary in us-west-2, then us-east-1. I'll open SEC ticket and include terraform snippets for the key policy change.
Jonah P.: add audit logging: ensure CloudTrail insights enabled for kms.amazonaws.com and set explicit org-level event selectors so Decrypts by these roles trigger an alert.
spec-oncall-bot: ALERT RULE CHECK: CloudTrail insights for kms.amazonaws.com = enabled, DecryptEventsDetector = enabled.
Emma L.: good catch. I'll attach logs to SEC-8102: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-8102 and ping compliance for evidence retention.
Safiya M.: one more ask: can we add a periodic reminder to product teams at 90d of inactivity? folks tend to forget to hand back access after project winds down.
Jonah P.: happy to add an automated workflow in entitlement-tracker: if role.lastUsed > 90d and owner!=active, create slack DM to owner and post in #new-hires for awareness.
Emma L.: filing the change plan now, will queue for a 2-hour maintenance window tomorrow morning. thanks all.
